qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for M6 screws on the timing case and top and bottom timing case cover?
What torque value should be used for M8 bolts on the front/rear end cover to crankcase?
What is the highest torque specification shown on this page?
qa_pairs.answer: 65 Nm for M42x1.5 bolts on timing case cover (M51/M41 engines)

qa_pairs.question: Which engines use M42x1.5 bolts on the timing case cover?
What is the torque specification for the sealing plug or connector on timing case cover for M51/M41 engines?
What thread pitch is specified for the sealing plug or connector on timing case cover?
Are the M10 screw torque specifications the same for timing case covers and front/rear end covers?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, both use 47 Nm for M10 screws

qa_pairs.question: What section and subsection is this torque specification table from?
Do all engine types use the same torque specifications for M6 and M8 screws on case covers?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, all engine types use 10 Nm for M6 screws and 22 Nm for M8 screws

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque between M42x1.5 bolts and M20x1.5 sealing plugs on M51/M41 engines?
qa_pairs.answer: 35 Nm difference (65 Nm for M42x1.5 bolts vs 30 Nm for M20x1.5 sealing plugs)
